correctness: Every warmup and measurement is compared against an independent complex128 NumPy oracle; full state outputs retained externally. No threshold changes after measurements.
endian: logical qubit zero is most significant
memory_policy: Report allocator-specific observations separately. They are not comparable device-process peaks; no GPU memory ranking is allowed.
order: participant order alternates by fresh process block
scope: Complete backend state request from prebuilt logical gate list: native setup, zero-state initialization, evolution and full host state delivery. Imports and independent NumPy verification excluded.
transfer_policy: Zero state is initialized on device. No large host-to-device initial-state transfer; matrix preparation/upload belongs to setup. Full state device-to-host copy timed separately.
